name: gigem-v2
description: Texas A&M football score prediction game on Cloudflare Workers

scripts.db:e2e:reset: rm -rf .wrangler/e2e && wrangler d1 migrations apply gigem --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e && wrangler d1 execute gigem --local --persist-to .wrangler/e2e --file=tests/e2e/fixtures.sql
scripts.deploy: npm run typecheck && npm run db:migrate:remote && wrangler deploy
